forest.title: Forest
forest.description: Go to the forest, you can find some resources there. Safe, but you may encounter creatures.
success_messages: You spent some time exploring the forest. It was a productive trip.
The forest seemed calm today, and your exploration went smoothly.
You navigated through the trees and had a decent experience.
Your time in the forest was well-spent, and you feel accomplished.
failure_messages: You had trouble finding anything useful and decided to return.
The forest was quiet, but you couldn't make much progress.
Despite your efforts, the exploration didn't go as planned.
You wandered around for a while but had to head back empty-handed.

mountains.title: Mountains
mountains.description: Explore the mountains to find rare resources. Dangerous terrain with a higher chance of failure.
success_messages: The climb was challenging, but you made good progress.
You spent time in the mountains and gained valuable experience.
Despite the tough terrain, your exploration went better than expected.
Your journey through the mountains was worth the effort.
failure_messages: The rough terrain slowed you down, and you had to turn back.
Your path was blocked, forcing you to cut the exploration short.
A sudden change in weather made it too risky to continue.
You tried your best, but the mountains proved too difficult this time.
